title: All-in-one small business app
summary: One app for all small business needs.
whyItFails: Breadth vs depth. Can't beat specialists. Sales costs. SMBs are expensive to acquire. Churn. Businesses close frequently.
whatWouldChange: AI that makes building breadth cheaper.

attempts.notes: Bookkeeping and tax for small businesses; raised about $113 million and went offline without notice in December 2024.
SAP's all-in-one e-commerce, marketing, inventory and analytics suite for small businesses; closed with almost immediate effect.

reasons.detail: Breadth vs depth: Can't beat specialists.
Sales costs: SMBs are expensive to acquire.
